title: 護理技術
intro: 基礎與進階護理技術：生命徵象、給藥、管路照護與病人安全。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Fundamental and advanced nursing: vital signs, medication, line/tube care and patient safety. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 生命徵象測量
procedures.patient: 依課程「生命徵象測量」設定的虛擬情境：體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓與 SpO2 的標準流程與判讀。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Vital signs measurement": Temperature, pulse, respiration, blood pressure and SpO2 technique and interpretation. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
